summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Ascentage Pharma Group International, a Chinese biopharmaceutical company, reporting three press releases issued on May 31, 2026, regarding clinical data presentations at the ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting. The press releases cover updates on the company's drug candidates alrizomadlin and olverembatinib in various cancer indications. There are no special-situation corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes described. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and does not involve any corporate action requiring special-situations classification. Therefore, no deal terms or strategic corporate event is present.
